Seed 104729 · Contract saved locally
Fullscreen
Know your tools. Read your quarry.

Keep the hunter alive and defeat the final contract. The arena shows the fight; the side panels show the exact rules.

1
Spend energy deliberately

Start each turn with 5 energy and 5 cards. A card’s corner shows its cost. Unplayed cards enter discard at turn end. When draw runs out, discard reshuffles.

2
Deploy a binding

Creature cards occupy one of 6 binding slots. They remain through the fight. Their cards stay out of your piles while alive; fallen creatures return to discard.

3
Give an explicit command

Select a ready creature, then an enemy. One free command per creature each turn, including its arrival turn. Targeted tools also wait for your choice. Use each creature’s Inspect button (i) to read traits.

4
Read every intent

Enemy panels show their next target, damage, guard, or reinforcements. Intents resolve in order when you End turn. If a marked creature falls, its attacker hits the hunter. Block expires at your next turn; some enemies explicitly ignore it.

End turn

A debt in blood

Clear the hostile ground. Earn gold and choose a creature or tool.

Accept

observation.dialog:
Know your tools. Read your quarry.

Keep the hunter alive and defeat the final contract. The arena shows the fight; the side panels show the exact rules.

1
Spend energy deliberately

Start each turn with 5 energy and 5 cards. A card’s corner shows its cost. Unplayed cards enter discard at turn end. When draw runs out, discard reshuffles.

2
Deploy a binding

Creature cards occupy one of 6 binding slots. They remain through the fight. Their cards stay out of your piles while alive; fallen creatures return to discard.

3
Give an explicit command

Select a ready creature, then an enemy. One free command per creature each turn, including its arrival turn. Targeted tools also wait for your choice. Use each creature’s Inspect button (i) to read traits.

4
Read every intent

Enemy panels show their next target, damage, guard, or reinforcements. Intents resolve in order when you End turn. If a marked creature falls, its attacker hits the hunter. Block expires at your next turn; some enemies explicitly ignore it.

E
End turn
Esc
Cancel / pause
Tab
Navigate
Enter
Choose
Accept field orders
